dedupe_keys.name: integrated sustainability assessment of offshore floating pv systems

description: Keller, Heiko and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The completed project assessment evaluates environmental, economic, technological and social aspects of offshore floating-photovoltaic configurations in representative European marine environments. Separate environmental and social reports are grouped as components of the same integrated assessment, with an associated LCA presentation retained as documentation. These source-defined representative deployments are assessment scenarios, not verified commercial installations. The environmental report compares material flows and greenhouse emissions with conventional electricity options; exact inventory access and system-boundary details remain unknown. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. This record represents the documented application and its stated scope. Publication access does not imply that its underlying measurements or implementation are public. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The integrated assessment complements the separate SUREWAVE economic workbook.
